# 1189. Maximum Number of Balloons

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maxNumberOfBalloons(self, text):
        """
        :type text: str
        :rtype: int
        """
        d = collections.Counter(text)
        return min(d['a'], d['b'], int(d['l'] / 2), d['n'], int(d['o'] / 2))
```
